app.name: LlamaDesk
app.tagline: Your links, your tools, your contexts — in order.

onboarding.subtitle: A local-first launcher for your links, tools and project contexts. No account, no cloud, no telemetry — your data never leaves this computer.

pillars.localDesc: An SQLite file in your user folder. Nothing else.
pillars.privateDesc: No tracking, no analytics, no network calls.
pillars.yoursDesc: Empty on day one. You build the structure.

empty.title: Your workspace is empty
empty.description: Start by creating your first project, or add an application with its links.

widgets.noFavorites: Mark an application as favourite to find it here.
widgets.noRecents: What you open will show up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.themeDesc: Follow the system or force a mode.
settings.startMinimizedDesc: Launch into the system tray without opening the window.
settings.closeToTrayDesc: Closing the window keeps LlamaDesk running in the tray.
settings.autostartDesc: Launch LlamaDesk automatically when you sign in.
settings.globalShortcutDesc: Opens the command palette from anywhere.
settings.shortcutFailed: This shortcut is already taken by another application. Pick a different one.
settings.openDelayDesc: Milliseconds between each tab when opening a whole workspace.
settings.overlayOpacityDesc: Darkens the wallpaper to keep text perfectly readable.
settings.privacyBody: LlamaDesk makes no network requests. No analytics, no crash reporting, no update pings. Your links, tags and notes stay in a single local SQLite file.
settings.shortcutHint: Global shortcuts work even when the window is hidden in the tray. If one cannot be registered, another application already owns it — the in-window shortcut keeps working anyway.

palette.hint: Type to search applications, links and projects.

bulk.title: Protected items in this workspace
bulk.message: This selection contains {{count}} protected item(s) out of {{total}}. Do you want to continue?

danger.promptsHint: Built-in dialogs follow the interface language. Edit one to get an editable copy.
danger.builtinLocked: Built-in dialogs cannot be modified: editing one creates a copy.

errors.invalidUrl: This address cannot be opened: only http, https and mailto links are allowed.

navigator.noApplicationsHint: An application is a tool with one or more links — Camunda with its Admin, Tasklist and Operate URLs, for example.

health.title: Dormant links
health.summary_one: {{count}} link has not been opened in a long time.
health.summary_other: {{count}} links have not been opened in a long time.
health.dormantHint: Computed from your local history only — LlamaDesk never contacts these addresses.
health.thresholdDesc: Days without opening before a link is flagged.

notes.title: Note
notes.placeholder: A local note for this item. Saved automatically.

workspaces.subtitle: Sets of links that open together, across projects and environments.
workspaces.emptyHint: Create one and add the links you always open together — they can come from different projects.

capture.title: Quick capture
capture.subtitle: The URL comes from your clipboard, read only when you press the shortcut.
capture.noUrl: The clipboard does not contain a valid http, https or mailto address. Paste it below.
capture.noDestination: No destination found. Create an environment or a group first.
capture.shortcutDesc: Reads an URL from the clipboard and opens the capture dialog.

appearance.wallpaperHint: The layer every glass panel samples. On Windows the blur cannot reach the desktop behind the window, so this is what gives the interface its colour.

data.title: Backup and restore
data.description: A JSON file with your whole configuration: profiles, hierarchy, links, tags, notes and workspaces. No credentials — there are none — and no usage history.
data.mergeHint: Everything is imported with new ids, next to your current data.
data.replaceHint: Deletes your current data and restores the backup. A copy of the database is saved first.
